en.headline: Ka Ying Rising extends winning streak to 21 in Chief Executive’s Cup
en.dek: The world’s top sprinter won the Group Three feature at Sha Tin by nearly eight lengths, lowering the track record on the opening day of the new season.
body: Ka Ying Rising began the 2026/27 racing season the way he finished the last one, cruising to a record-extending 21st consecutive victory in the HKSAR Chief Executive’s Cup at Sha Tin on Sunday.

Ridden by Zac Purton and trained by David Hayes, the Horse of the Year carried 135 lb in the 1,200-metre Group Three handicap and won by 7¾ lengths. He stopped the clock in 1:06.11, cutting nearly a second from the previous track record.

Copartner Prance finished second and Magic Control third. The race carried a purse of HK$4.2 million. Fans packed the course for the season opener, which also featured live music and a guest performance by singer Aaron Kwok.
Ka Ying Rising remains on course for further major targets later in the campaign, including The Everest in Australia next month.

zh.headline: 嘉應高昇首席行政長官盃連勝第21場
zh.dek: 世界頂級短途馬周日在沙田開鑼日以近八個馬位勝出三級賽，並打破場地紀錄。
body: 上季馬王嘉應高昇周日在沙田馬場新馬季開鑼日，勝出香港特區行政長官盃，將連勝紀錄延伸至21場。
由潘頓策騎、大衛希斯訓練的嘉應高昇背負135磅出戰1200米三級賽，最終以七又四分三個馬位大勝，跑出1分6秒11，打破場地紀錄近一秒。
第二名是同樂舞蹈，第三名是魔法控制。赛事獎金420萬元。當日馬場亦有現場音樂及歌手郭富城表演，吸引大批觀眾。
嘉應高昇稍後仍會出戰其他主要目標，包括下月在澳洲舉行的Everest短途大賽。
